[[Category:Regression analysis]]
'''Sum of squared errors''' ('''SSE''') is the sum of the squares of the [[errors and residuals|residuals]] between observed values and fitted values.

== Definition ==

{{#content:Q3085}}

Thus

$$
\mathrm{SSE}\ge 0,
\qquad
\mathrm{SSE}=0
\iff
\forall i\in\{1,\dots,n\},\ y_i=\hat y_i.
$$
